newsitem.title: UK: UK's house prices rise 0.7 pct in Jan - Nationwide.
newsitem.headline: UK's house prices rise 0.7 pct in Jan - Nationwide.

text.p: The Nationwide Building Society released the following UK house price data -
HOUSE PRICES (index base Q1 1993=100) Jan Dec Jan,96
NOTE - Paul Sanderson, Nationwide's head of research, said recent data suggested the housing market was entering 1997 with a sound recovery well underway.
"The upward trend in prices continues and there is welcome evidence this is now encouraging a more broadly based upturn in sales as more properties come on to the market," he said.
"There is every reason to expect the recovery to be sustained through 1997, given a generally positive economic environment and the prospect of solid gains in personal incomes," Sanderson added.
